question: What spatial extent and luminous form characterize the kāmakalā visualization?
premises: The visualization extends from the root to the brahmarandhra.
It is described as having the form of a shining lamp.
These qualities define the meditative image.
inference: The practitioner should visualize kāmakalā as a shining lamp extending from the root to the brahmarandhra.
plain_english: One should visualize her as a shining lamp extending from the root up to the brahmarandhra.
